/*
================================================================================
项目：蜡笔小新首日低付费率诊断
方法：完整自然日创角 cohort，按保守活跃分钟与最高等级分层，对比付费率。
活跃分钟：相邻非 app 事件间隔 0~119 秒累计。
刷新参数：2026-07-29 至 2026-07-29；本查询固定复盘开服首日 2026-07-29。
================================================================================
*/

WITH TC_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Blacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
SG_Android AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_os' AND tag_value = 'Android'
),
SG_Singapore AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name = 'fixed_country' AND tag_value = '新加坡'
),
RawEvents AS (
    SELECT
        '繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        v."#event_name" AS event_name,
        v."#event_time" AS event_time,
        TRY_CAST(v.role_lev AS BIGINT) AS role_level,
        v.sandbox,
        v.is_freebuy
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN TC_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_date" = '2026-07-29' AND b.user_id IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '新加坡Android' AS cohort_name,
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        v."#event_name" AS event_name,
        v."#event_time" AS event_time,
        TRY_CAST(v.role_lev AS BIGINT) AS role_level,
        v.sandbox,
        v.is_freebuy
    FROM ta.v_event_13 v
    INNER JOIN SG_Android a ON v."#user_id" = a.user_id
    INNER JOIN SG_Singapore s ON v."#user_id" = s.user_id
    LEFT JOIN SG_Blacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_date" = '2026-05-08' AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT cohort_name, account_id
    FROM RawEvents
    WHERE event_name = 'new_role' AND account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
Events AS (
    SELECT r.*
    FROM RawEvents r
    INNER JOIN CohortUsers c
      ON r.cohort_name = c.cohort_name
     AND r.account_id = c.account_id
),
EventGaps AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        account_id,
        DATE_DIFF(
            'second',
            CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP),
            LEAD(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) OVER (
                PARTITION BY cohort_name, account_id ORDER BY event_time
            )
        ) AS next_gap_seconds
    FROM Events
    WHERE event_name NOT LIKE '%app%'
),
Duration AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN next_gap_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 119 THEN next_gap_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 AS active_minutes
    FROM EventGaps
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
Profile AS (
    SELECT
        c.cohort_name,
        c.account_id,
        COALESCE(d.active_minutes, 0) AS active_minutes,
        MAX(e.role_level) AS max_level,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN e.event_name = 'charge'
             AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
             AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS payer
    FROM CohortUsers c
    LEFT JOIN Events e
      ON c.cohort_name = e.cohort_name AND c.account_id = e.account_id
    LEFT JOIN Duration d
      ON c.cohort_name = d.cohort_name AND c.account_id = d.account_id
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
Segments AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        account_id,
        payer,
        '活跃时长' AS dimension_name,
        CASE
            WHEN active_minutes < 5 THEN '01.<5分钟'
            WHEN active_minutes < 15 THEN '02.5-15分钟'
            WHEN active_minutes < 30 THEN '03.15-30分钟'
            WHEN active_minutes < 60 THEN '04.30-60分钟'
            ELSE '05.60分钟以上'
        END AS segment_name
    FROM Profile

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        account_id,
        payer,
        '最高等级' AS dimension_name,
        CASE
            WHEN max_level IS NULL OR max_level < 10 THEN '01.<10级'
            WHEN max_level < 20 THEN '02.10-19级'
            WHEN max_level < 30 THEN '03.20-29级'
            WHEN max_level < 40 THEN '04.30-39级'
            ELSE '05.40级以上'
        END AS segment_name
    FROM Profile
)
SELECT
    cohort_name AS "用户组",
    dimension_name AS "诊断维度",
    segment_name AS "分层",
    COUNT(*) AS "用户数",
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (
        PARTITION BY cohort_name, dimension_name
    ), 2) AS "用户占比(%)",
    SUM(payer) AS "付费人数",
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(payer) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "付费率(%)"
FROM Segments
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 2, 3, 1;
